en.advancedRuleHint: Use a single RFC 5545 RRULE without DTSTART.
en.approvalAskWarning: This permission asks for approval. Unattended runs never auto-approve and may wait until their timeout.
en.confirmPermissionChange: I confirm future runs may use {permission}.
en.createHint: Give recurring work a schedule. Choose an example or start a new task, then confirm what to do and when in a conversation.
en.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? Existing run sessions will remain.
en.deleteRunBlocked: Wait until execution and message delivery have finished before deleting this record.
en.deleteRunConfirm: Only this run record will be deleted. Its session and sent messages are kept, and future runs are unaffected. This cannot be undone.
en.deleteRunFailed: Could not delete the record: {error}. You can try again.
en.deliveryHelpText: Send Automation results and failure reports through dsh-im installed on the same Host. Configure a bot and save a target in dsh-im first. No pinned Session or two-way sync is required.
en.deliveryHint: Enabling sends results outside DSH. Saved changes apply to future runs.
en.deliveryLocked: Wait until queued or running work finishes before changing delivery.
en.deliveryNoBots: No bots available. Configure a bot in dsh-im, then refresh.
en.deliveryNoTargets: No saved targets. Add a target in dsh-im settings, then refresh.
en.deliverySavedUnavailable: The saved bot or target is unavailable. Keep it unchanged, choose another, or turn delivery off.
en.deliverySaveHint: Saving sends future task results and failure reports outside DSH to {bot} / {target}.
en.deliveryUnavailable: dsh-im delivery is unavailable. You can keep the saved destination or turn delivery off.
en.discardDescription: Your changes have not been saved. Keep editing or discard them to continue.
en.editorConfigInvalid: Review agent execution and permissions: some selected options are unavailable or incomplete.
en.editorRequiredFields: Complete the required fields; values cannot contain only spaces.
en.exampleDependenciesPrompt: Create a recurring automation for every Monday at 9:30 AM in my current time zone. Name it “Dependency watch”. When it runs, inspect dependency manifests and lockfiles for important updates, compatibility risks, and security concerns without modifying files. Report high-risk findings first and give a concrete recommendation for each. Use read-only permission, notify me after every run, and pause after 3 consecutive failures. Before creating it, show the complete creation preview and wait for my confirmation.
en.exampleDraftHint: Nothing is sent automatically. Review or rewrite the prompt, then send it when ready.
en.exampleHandoffPrompt: Create a recurring automation for every weekday at 6:00 PM in my current time zone. Name it “Daily handoff”. When it runs, inspect today’s workspace changes without modifying files and produce a concise handoff with Completed, Decisions, Next actions, and Blockers. Use read-only permission and notify me after every run. Before creating it, show the complete creation preview and wait for my confirmation.
en.exampleReleasePrompt: Create a one-time automation for tomorrow at 9:00 AM in my current time zone. Name it “Release readiness check”. When it runs, inspect this workspace for release blockers and run relevant existing checks without modifying source files. End with Ready or Blocked, followed by blockers and evidence. Use read-only permission and notify me only if the run fails. Before creating it, show the complete creation preview and wait for my confirmation.
en.guidedCreationPrompt: Help me create a new automation for this workspace. Ask only for missing essentials. Use automation_options before selecting Host ids. Before creating it, preview Name, Schedule/time zone, Workspace, Agent preset, Provider/Model, Reasoning effort (default or a supported level), ordered Skills, exact Host Permission, Notifications, and failure-pause policy, including any approval warning; then wait for my explicit confirmation. Do not call automation_create until I confirm.
en.loadFailedHint: Check the connection and try again. No tasks have been changed.
en.newConversationFailed: Could not open a new conversation: {error}
en.noSessionMatches: No matching sessions in this workspace.
en.noSkills: No user-invocable skills are available for this preset.
en.pinnedSessionHint: Append each run to this session with its existing context and Agent/model configuration; skills are not reloaded. The task’s permission preset is applied to the session. Busy or unavailable sessions fail without creating a new one.
en.reasoningHint: Default leaves reasoning settings unchanged. Other levels come from the selected model.
en.reasoningSelectModel: Choose a provider and model to set a reasoning level.
en.reasoningUnavailable: The Host did not return reasoning options. Restart DSH if the plugin was just updated.
en.reasoningUnsupported: This model does not offer selectable reasoning levels.
en.requiresWorkspace: Open a workspace first to create an automation.
en.schedulerRetrying: Scheduling temporarily failed and will retry automatically: {error}
en.schedulerStopped: Scheduling is stopped. Restart DSH to resume automations.
en.selectTaskHint: Select an automation to see its schedule, configuration, and run history.
en.sessionsNotReady: No session list was received. Try again.
en.sessionTargetLocked: Wait until queued or running work finishes before changing the session.

en.sessionWorkspaceHint: Only sessions in this task’s workspace: {cwd}
